propositions: The .bridge_state artifact survives the store-copy scrub after run_ensures converges the fixture, causing test_the_store_copy_is_complete_and_scrubbed to fail with assertion 'binding/snapshot artifacts survived the scrub'.

The projects-seed ensure unit (added in commit 72731d3745) unconditionally recreates and commits .bridge_state/projects.json when git show misses it, resurrecting the artifact after the one-shot scrub removed it.
The regression is an ordering issue: the ensure unit post-dates the scrub, and before the seed unit was added, run_ensures created nothing under .bridge_state, so the scrub removal persisted.
Re-running the .bridge_state* scrub after run_ensures converges the store removes resurrected artifacts from both worktree and tickets tree while preserving the .env-id store marker.
A fast unit test drives the real seed unit to reproduce the resurrection as a negative control and validates that the post-converge scrub leaves no .bridge_state* and a clean git tree.
